description: Suggest OrbitStudio settings for a 3D-printed puzzle or ornament of a place, from the app's own defaults and the limits of that world's elevation data, plus a link that opens the app at the place with those settings filled in, ready for the user to press Generate. Use it when the user wants to make or print a model of a specific place. Give either a place from search_places or latitude and longitude (a coordinate link cannot carry settings). Shape, size and relief may be chosen; otherwise the app's defaults apply.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees, if no place is given.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees east, if no place is given.

place.description: Place name or id from search_places, e.g. 'tycho'.

purpose.description: puzzle for a jigsaw puzzle; ornament, gift or display for a solid model.

relief.description: Terrain Height Scale; 1 is true scale. Defaults to the world's own starting value.

size_mm.description: Printed width or diameter in mm (rounded to 10); fit it to the printer's bed.

world.description: Which world: moon, mars, mercury, venus, jupiter, pluto, vesta, ceres, mimas, enceladus, tethys or charon (only the ones OrbitStudio currently offers are accepted).

name: suggest_model
title: Suggest model settings
